program.name: Fighter Legs
program.subject: Fighter
program.blurb: Legs that last a fight: kick bouts with leg strength, punch bouts with calves and hops.
program.about: Fighters live on their legs. One day pairs kick bouts with squats, lunges and adductor work; the other punch bouts with calf raises, hops and footwork. Legs that keep you moving and kicking in the last round. Level II adds reps and Level III asks for heavier weights.
